approved_builder_proposals: Workspace is the collaboration and security boundary without implicit administrator access to project data.
Legacy unassigned threads migrate to the global Inbox with private-owner visibility.
Agents are propose-only by default and require explicit assignment capability for structured writes.
Membership, promotion, policy, reconciliation import, and methodological schema-profile changes require human approval.
Projection refresh retries three times with bounded backoff before reconciliation is blocked and alerted.
The maize-v1 profile uses the generic breeding core with versioned extension attributes.
notes: The human explicitly approved the complete phased action plan and subsequently approved implementation. A project-scoped Phase-2 Builder contract is active; the user-global GreenAgent installation remains unchanged.
